fusions.name: Forager's Line
fusions.desc: Sends a stinger into the first enemy it meets for 4 poison damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Work Gang
fusions.desc: A circling cut that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it. Its damage rises 6% for each ally near you (max 24%).

fusions.name: Cut Comb
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Field Workers
fusions.desc: A bonded swarm of field bees flies with you, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill restores 2 health to you.
